narrative: OMX30 opens into a well-established bull regime with strong DAX/CAC tailwinds and 0.89 correlation bias supporting upside. Technical positioning remains constructive—MACD above signal, ADX at 60.9, and price 9.8% above 200-MA all confirm bullish structure. However, RSI 78.41 and Stochastic K 91.4 both flash overbought warnings, signaling meaningful mean-reversion risk into any weakness. The 52-week high at current levels leaves little room for further breakout, and positioning crowding warrants caution on aggressive new longs. USD/SEK strength (+0.58%) and copper rally (+2.94%) offer sector-specific tailwinds for Volvo, Atlas Copco, and Boliden, while rising yields (+1.76%) support bank NIM expansion. Key watch: any break below 3,123 invalidates the overnight bullish setup.
morningBrief: OMX30 set to gap higher on eurozone strength and positive correlation flows; DAX +2.39% and CAC +1.56% provide solid overnight momentum. MACD bullish crossover, ADX 60.9, and price 9.8% above 200-MA all support a bullish lean, but RSI 78.41 and Stochastic 91.4 scream mean-reversion risk—treat rallies with discipline. Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo, Sandvik) benefit from USD/SEK strength; Boliden and mining upside on copper +2.94% and gold +1.79%. Banks (SEB, Handelsbanken, Swedbank) likely to catch bid from US yields +1.76% widening NIM outlook. Crude down -5.90% is a net positive for consumer/transport margins. Watch the 3,123 level (yesterday's close) as support; any dip should find 3,085 (lower Bollinger), but break below risks accelerated profit-taking. Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET could rattle sentiment late morning.
